thread:
maria: Heads up — canary (3%) is showing a p95 regression after yesterday's merge. CI perf check flagged +18% p95 on small-batch workloads. Logs attached :eyes:
jon: Saw the alert. Do we have a bisect running?
maria: Starting a bisect now against staging merges. Suspect the kernel-autoselect policy tweak from PR #812.
perf-ci-bot: perf-ci failed: p95 delta 18% > threshold(15%) on test `batch_small_seq128` (build #2467).
tess: Can we pause the rollout until we know more? Current canary is 3% but we should avoid ramp. :hand:  
ryan: Agreed. Suggest setting rollout.autopause=true and hold at current percentage. Will also add a 5% manual gate for any further moves.
maria: Set autopause flag and added a note in the release thread. Created a revert candidate if bisect pins a commit.
jon: Bisect results: commit abc1234 (kernel: prefer-low-latency) correlates with regressions. KV cache miss rate up ~30% on short sequences in profiling.
tess: That commit touched the prefetch heuristic — maybe it's evicting prefixes too aggressively.
maria: Quick profiling snippet from staging:
```
kv_cache_hits: 70 -> 48
kv_cache_misses: 30 -> 52
p95_latency_ms: 48 -> 63
hotpath: kernel_autoselect_choose(low_latency)
```
jon: Looks like churn in KV cache + different kernel choice for short seqs. Batching heuristics unchanged.
ryan: Proposal: automatic rollback guard when either p95 delta > 10% OR kv_miss_rate increase > 15% sustained for 10m across canary nodes. Rollback should require 3 consecutive 2m windows to avoid flapping.
tess: +1 on thresholds. Also require a short cooldown (10m) before auto-unpause to let metrics settle.
perf-ci-bot: added alert rule `canary_perf_guard` with those thresholds; will trigger `deploy-bot` if condition holds.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by bot (reason: perf_guard alert armed).
maria: I reverted abc1234 on staging and re-ran the same workload. Preliminary numbers: p95 back to baseline and kv miss rate returned to ~5% delta.
jon: Confirmed on multiple runs, staging looks healthy after revert.
ryan: Action items: 1) Add a CI perf test that exercises the short-batch kernel path specifically. 2) Add a KV-cache telemetry tag to attribute miss causes (prefetch vs eviction). 3) Implement auto-rollback guard as described.
tess: Filing follow-up ticket INC-3241 for infra changes + CI tests.
maria: Thanks team. We'll keep the canary paused until the guard is in place and the new CI test passes. :thumbsup:
ryan: Also a note: update rollout docs to include the new autopause/rollback semantics so oncall knows the thresholds.
jon: If anyone wants the raw flame graphs or heap dumps I uploaded them to the release artifacts under `artifacts/abc1234/`.
maria: Upload pointers saved. Will circle back once the guard is live.
